description: This file contains utility methods related to Java generics, specifically for retrieving the generic entity class from a component definition class within the SalesManager framework. It includes reflection-based methods for analyzing class hierarchies and generic type parameters.

classes.name: GenericEntityUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for working with generic entity classes through reflection, primarily to obtain the class type parameter that extends SalesManagerEntity.

methods.name: getGenericEntityClassFromComponentDefinition
methods.description: A static method that, given a class, traverses its superclass hierarchy to identify and return the class that extends SalesManagerEntity, based on generic type parameters.
